read_back.description: Confirm the original operation receipt, separately from business success. Correlate the original Effect UUID in call arguments, reader arguments and an equals check. For a receipt status check, use one_of covering every documented terminal outcome, including unsuccessful outcomes, and exclude pending states. The reader output_schema defines fields and allowed values; its enum alone does not identify which values are terminal. Evaluate the actual operation status after receiving the confirmed receipt.

cancel_target.description: Optional original Effect UUID for an approved cancellation. Must belong to this Run and connection, and appear in call/read arguments and an equals read-back check.

title: mcp.call/v1 request
description: Approved MCP tools/call through change.propose/v1 only. Observe mcp.tools/v1 Evidence first. operation="call", target.locator=the authorized tool name. One /call SET value={"arguments":{"requestId":"${effect_id}",...},"read_back":{"name":"authorized_receipt_reader","arguments":{"requestId":"${effect_id}"},"checks":[{"path":"/requestId","equals":"${effect_id}"},{"path":"/status","one_of":["COMPLETED","ERROR","TIMEOUT","CANCELLED"]}]}}. Field names and terminal states in this example are illustrative: use the actual reader output_schema and tool documentation. Each check uses equals or one_of, with a JSON Pointer into the parsed read result. precondition.revision=catalog_hash; verification={"method":"READ_BACK","paths":["/call"]}. Both tools and all arguments/checks are approved together. Use the exact string ${effect_id} for a platform-owned operation ID; the platform substitutes the original Effect UUID. Read-back confirms the original terminal receipt, not business success. For receipt status checks, use one_of with all documented terminal outcomes, including unsuccessful outcomes, and exclude pending states. An enum alone does not identify terminal states. A confirmed error or timeout receipt is returned for the Agent to assess; confirmation does not imply success or authorize another action. Unknown outcomes are never resent. Original receipt recovery requires a read-back equals check against ${effect_id}; otherwise keep the outcome unknown. Application-specific prerequisites and business verdicts remain defined by the Skill. Returned URLs are not downloaded or saved artifacts. A cancellation may include cancel_target (original Effect UUID) in /call value; bind its arguments, reader arguments and equals check to that ID. The platform verifies Run ownership before permitting cancellation of a pending effect. Build checks only from actual output contracts or authorized observations, not inferred input fields. Every comparison value must be possible under the declared output schema. For identity-correlated receipts, a single-value status check is rejected before sending when the output_schema explicitly permits other statuses. Missing schema declarations are not proof of terminality. Read-only confirmation is bounded and never resends the action. Failures retain phase, safe diagnostic ID and unverified observations. An unverified response is not an applied receipt.
